input.task: Use the search_skills tool to find the most relevant skill for implementing a Node.js REST API. Search for something like 'node api' or 'hexagonal architecture node'. Pick the best result based on its description and scores. Install it using install_skill. Once installed, read it with read_skill and use the skill to implement a simple Node.js API in a hex-api/ directory that translates English text to hex — a single POST /translate endpoint. Also write a one-shot bash script (run-and-test.sh) that starts the server and fires a curl request against it.
